description: The 'users_prepared' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of user information, including login credentials, profile details, and activity metrics. This dataset is particularly useful for managing user accounts, analyzing user behavior, and tracking user engagement over time. Key features include email addresses, display names, user profiles, and group memberships, which help in identifying and categorizing users. Additionally, the dataset tracks user activity through timestamps of account creation, last successful login, and last session activity, allowing for detailed analysis of user engagement. The 'enabled' column indicates whether a user account is active, while the 'days_since_last_activity_or_login' provides insights into user inactivity. The dataset also includes URLs for user account management, facilitating easy access to user profiles. This dataset is ideal for administrators and analysts looking to monitor user activity, manage user accounts, and enhance user experience by understanding user interactions and engagement patterns.
shortDesc: User data with login, profile, and activity details.

columns.name: login
columns.comment: User's login email or username, identifies user.

columns.name: displayName
columns.comment: User's display name, shown in profiles.

columns.name: userProfile
columns.comment: User's role or profile type, defines access.

columns.name: sourceType
columns.comment: Origin of user account, e.g., LOCAL.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.comment: Account creation date and time, tracks origin.

columns.name: last_successful_login
columns.comment: Date of last successful login, tracks activity.

columns.name: last_session_activity
columns.comment: Date of last session activity, tracks engagement.

columns.name: days_since_last_activity_or_login
columns.comment: Days since last activity or login, measures inactivity.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL for user profile management, access link.

columns.name: creationDate
columns.comment: Date of account creation, tracks user origin.
